Clear: man in dark coat with bag exits (~10s), woman in blue hat exits behind the glass (~38-40s), older man in cap enters (~44s). Uncertain: a figure at the right edge at ~18s (counted as arrival) and a man in a cap heading right at ~22s then gone (counted as departure).

Door closed and out of view most of the minute; leaf swings into view at ~56s with an arm on it, nobody yet through. Yellow hat/coat blocks parts of several tiles.

A yellow knit hat close to the camera covers most of each tile from ~14s on; the right-edge strip stays mostly visible and shows nobody. Whoever opened the door at the end of the previous minute is not seen.
Man in black with cap walks in from the left side of the tile and stands at the wall by the right edge; hat blocks ~2-8s.
Man in black leans out at the right edge ~12-18s, apparently sitting down there rather than leaving (not counted); yellow hat covers much of the tiles from ~28s but the right edge mostly shows.
Yellow hat fills the tiles for roughly 20 of the 60 seconds (~8-26s); in the visible part two men stand near the right edge and one walks off to the left.
Yellow hat and a man in a green cap right at the lens cover much of the view; no one seen crossing the right edge in the visible parts.
Hat blocks most tiles, then from ~38s the camera is picked up/re-aimed and shows a different part of the room, so the door side is not observable for the rest of the minute.

Camera is hand-held/aimed at another part of the room nearly the whole minute, then covered by a hat; door side not observable. Several people not seen before (white-haired woman, man in blue jacket with bags, dark-haired man) are present, so arrivals likely happened unseen around now.
Camera still off-target or covered for ~12 of the first 20 seconds, then back on the usual view; nobody seen crossing the right edge in the visible 40s.

Door leaf edge shows at ~10s after an older man in an olive jacket walks to it; a heavy man in a blue jacket and at least one companion then come in and are greeted (hug), but heads close to the camera hide part of the group, so arrivals could be 1-3.

Door opens ~8-10s and a woman in grey coat, blue hat and red bag comes in (looks like the woman who left at 20580, about 14 min earlier); door opens again ~34s as a man in a beanie and black top walks out.

Older man in olive jacket goes to the door and out at ~10s (leaf edge visible), and comes back in at ~48s with the leaf in view again. A dark-haired man in black appears at the left right after the first swing; he may have come in then (not counted).
Two people photograph the wall all minute; a man in black joins them from the left; a cap near the lens intrudes at the bottom in the last 12s.
People cluster at the chairs by the right edge (woman takes off her coat, man in black on his phone) without crossing it; a cap near the lens covers the left of several tiles.

Door leaf opens ~48-52s as a man in a brown beanie and a second dark-clothed person close to the camera head out; the second exit is inferred, could be 1. People standing near the lens hide the edge at times.
Door leaf swings in ~12-16s and a grey-curly-haired person in a cream quilted jacket comes in, later hugging the white-haired woman.

Door opens at ~54s and a group comes in during the last three tiles: a masked man in a dark beanie and a man in a brown beanie (both look like the pair who left at 21660) plus a person in a reddish fur hat; they stand close to the lens so the count could be off by one.
Several people move about near the right edge (one bends at the chairs there) but nobody is seen crossing it.

Door leaf is held open ~40-52s while a group files in close to the camera: person in blue beanie with backpack, a long-haired woman, a person in a patterned headscarf and at least one man; bodies overlap so the true number is roughly 3-6.
The newly arrived group (5-6 people) stands between the camera and the right edge all minute; no door leaf seen, but individual crossings could not have been seen.

Door leaf edge is in view for the first ~4s but nobody is seen crossing; the group near it moves off (members are seen still inside next minute), so whoever used the door is unknown. Quiet afterwards.

Person in patterned headscarf leaves ~10-16s; door opens again ~36s with a person in an olive parka at the edge (counted as an arrival, uncertain); blue-beanie woman with backpack and long-haired woman leave ~52-56s.

Door leaf is open ~40-50s while a cluster forms at it; a woman in a dark coat and hat with a red bag and one more person in a brimmed hat appear to come in, but a cap right at the lens and overlapping bodies make it 1-3.
